subtitle.zh: 使用本網站即表示您同意遵守這些服務條款。我們感謝您參與我們的社群，並鼓勵您仔細閱讀這些條款。
subtitle.en: By using this website, you agree to comply with these terms of service. We appreciate your participation in our community and encourage you to read these terms carefully.

paragraphs.zh: 本網站不保證學生評論的準確性或正確性，對於用戶提交評論中包含的任何不正確、誤導性或虛假資訊概不負責。所有評論僅代表個別學生的意見和經歷，可能存在顯著差異。用戶在解讀評論內容時應自行判斷。
paragraphs.en: This website does not guarantee the accuracy or correctness of student reviews and is not responsible for any incorrect, misleading, or false information contained in user-submitted reviews. All reviews represent individual student opinions and experiences, which may vary significantly. Users should exercise their own judgment when interpreting review content.

paragraphs.zh: 為了維護良好的社區環境，用戶必須遵守以下行為準則：
paragraphs.en: To maintain a positive community environment, users must follow these conduct guidelines:

paragraphs.zh: • 禁止使用粗言穢語或不當言論
paragraphs.en: • No profanity or inappropriate language

paragraphs.zh: • 禁止人身攻擊或針對個人的惡意言論
paragraphs.en: • No personal attacks or malicious comments targeting individuals

paragraphs.zh: • 禁止發送垃圾信息或重複無意義的內容
paragraphs.en: • No spam or repetitive meaningless content

paragraphs.zh: • 保持尊重和建設性的討論態度
paragraphs.en: • Maintain respectful and constructive discussion

paragraphs.zh: 違反上述準則可能導致帳戶被暫停或永久封禁
paragraphs.en: Violation of these guidelines may result in account suspension or permanent ban

paragraphs.zh: 為了維護專注且相關的討論環境：
paragraphs.en: To maintain a focused and relevant discussion environment:

paragraphs.zh: • 不允許政治討論
paragraphs.en: • Political discussions are not permitted

paragraphs.zh: • 不允許宗教討論
paragraphs.en: • Religious discussions are not permitted

paragraphs.zh: • 不允許與網站目的無關的內容
paragraphs.en: • Content unrelated to the site's purpose is not permitted

paragraphs.zh: • 請將討論重點放在課程和講師評論上
paragraphs.en: • Please keep discussions focused on course and lecturer reviews

paragraphs.zh: 無關或不當內容將在不通知的情況下被刪除
paragraphs.en: Unrelated or inappropriate content will be removed without notice

paragraphs.zh: 用戶需對其選擇的用戶名負責：
paragraphs.en: Users are responsible for their chosen usernames:

paragraphs.zh: • 冒犯性、不當或誤導性的用戶名可能會在不通知的情況下被更改
paragraphs.en: • Offensive, inappropriate, or misleading usernames may be changed without notice

paragraphs.zh: • 用戶名更改由管理團隊自行決定
paragraphs.en: • Username changes are at the discretion of the management team

paragraphs.zh: • 用戶有責任確保其用戶名符合社區標準

paragraphs.zh: 我們保留審核和管理平台內容的權利：
paragraphs.en: We reserve the right to moderate and manage platform content:

paragraphs.zh: • 不當評論將被刪除，且不會事先通知
paragraphs.en: • Inappropriate comments will be removed without prior notice

paragraphs.zh: • 我們致力於維護高質量的討論環境
paragraphs.en: • We are committed to maintaining a high-quality discussion environment

paragraphs.zh: • 管理決定將基於社區準則和管理團隊的判斷
paragraphs.en: • Moderation decisions are based on community guidelines and management team judgment

paragraphs.zh: 我們承諾保護您的隱私：
paragraphs.en: We are committed to protecting your privacy:

paragraphs.zh: • 詳細的數據收集政策請參閱隱私政策
paragraphs.en: • For detailed data collection policies, please refer to our Privacy Policy

paragraphs.zh: 我們可能會不時更新這些條款。重大變更將通過網站公告通知用戶。
paragraphs.en: We may update these terms from time to time. Major changes will be announced through website notifications.

paragraphs.zh: 如果您對這些條款有任何疑問，請通過網站聯繫功能與我們聯繫。
paragraphs.en: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us through the website contact feature.
